headline: Colombia Seeks $300 Million Loan for Air Traffic Control Modernization
summary: The Colombian government is seeking a $300 million loan to modernize its air traffic control systems. The 2026–2030 plan includes the intervention of 67 aeronautical stations.
why: Infrastructure investment is a key component of national economic development, impacting logistics efficiency and aviation safety standards.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Increased public debt to fund infrastructure improvements.
